name: ta_tuple_outputs_indicators
source: pyne-defined TA tuple output capture fixture
script:
macd_line, macd_signal, macd_hist = ta.macd(close, 4, 8, 3)
bb_mid, bb_upper, bb_lower = ta.bb(close, 5, 1.5)
plus_di, minus_di, adx = ta.dmi(5, 4)
plot(macd_line, "MACD 4 8 Line")
plot(macd_signal, "MACD 4 8 Signal")
bar(macd_hist, "MACD 4 8 Hist")
plot(macd_line - macd_signal, "MACD Line Minus Signal")
plot(bb_mid, "BB 5 Mid")
plot(bb_upper, "BB 5 Upper")
plot(bb_lower, "BB 5 Lower")
plot(bb_upper - bb_lower, "BB 5 Width")
plot((close - bb_mid) / (bb_upper - bb_lower), "BB 5 Relative")
plot(plus_di, "Plus DI 5")
plot(minus_di, "Minus DI 5")
plot(adx, "ADX 5 4")
plot(plus_di - minus_di, "DI Spread 5")
pine_equivalent:
//@version=5
indicator("TA Tuple Outputs Golden")
[macd_line, macd_signal, macd_hist] = ta.macd(close, 4, 8, 3)
[bb_mid, bb_upper, bb_lower] = ta.bb(close, 5, 1.5)
[plus_di, minus_di, adx] = ta.dmi(5, 4)
plot(macd_line, "MACD 4 8 Line")
plot(macd_signal, "MACD 4 8 Signal")
plot(macd_hist, "MACD 4 8 Hist", style=plot.style_columns)
plot(macd_line - macd_signal, "MACD Line Minus Signal")
plot(bb_mid, "BB 5 Mid")
plot(bb_upper, "BB 5 Upper")
plot(bb_lower, "BB 5 Lower")
plot(bb_upper - bb_lower, "BB 5 Width")
plot((close - bb_mid) / (bb_upper - bb_lower), "BB 5 Relative")
plot(plus_di, "Plus DI 5")
plot(minus_di, "Minus DI 5")
plot(adx, "ADX 5 4")
plot(plus_di - minus_di, "DI Spread 5")

notes: TradingView export 2026-06-02, BINANCE:BTCUSDT.P 60m, tuple-output TA capture; 1e-7 tolerance covers CSV float tail differences.
